# Fun Around Me

> > Fun Around Me is a location-based activity discovery platform that helps users find entertainment, attractions, events, and dining options near them across major US cities and destinations.

Fun Around Me provides comprehensive guides to activities, events, and attractions in popular destinations including Atlanta, Austin, Boston, Chicago, Denver, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and many others. The platform combines local discovery with travel planning tools to help users explore entertainment options by category, location, and type.

## Key Topics

- Activity Discovery
- Location-Based Search
- City Guides
- Entertainment Finder
- Local Activities
- Events Discovery
- Attractions Directory
- Category Browsing
- Travel Planning
- Destination Explorer
- Place Types
- Activity Recommendations
- National Parks
- Restaurant Discovery

## Core Discovery

- [Find Fun Activities & Events Near You](https://www.funaroundme.com): Homepage for Fun Around Me - discover activities, events, and attractions near you.
- [Browse Categories](https://www.funaroundme.com/categories): Browse activities and places by category including restaurants, attractions, parks.

## Destination & Travel Planning

- [Explore Cities & National Parks](https://www.funaroundme.com/explore): Explore destinations across US, Europe, India and National Parks with activity guides.
- [Content Hubs](https://www.funaroundme.com/hubs): Travel guides, how-to guides, itineraries and destination planning resources.
